name: Paige
source:
Paige knows she'll never be able to light up a scoreboard, so she does her best work in the background and keep her team from breaking under the pressure. Unfortunately, she doesn't deal well with insults, especially when they are aimed at her teammates. 


[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=37386]Lemmasoftl[/url]]
